Reading guides

Organize Series, Volumes and a Private Library

A Series groups related books; each Volume is one book inside it. Use these controls to tidy an imported collection and find your next read.

These steps describe Panelune 1.1.1 on iPad. Menu locations may differ in later versions. Panelune 1.1.1 is available for iPad. Version 1.2.0, with iPhone support and reading improvements, has been submitted for Apple review and is not yet available.

On this page

  1. Understand Series and Volumes
  2. Correct names and grouping
  3. Return to the book you were reading
  4. Put selected Series in Private Library

Understand Series and Volumes

Open All Comics for your comic collection or All Novels for novels. Tap a Series to see its Volumes, then open a Volume to read. Use EPUB for novels and PDF or supported CBZ/ZIP image archives for comics.

File metadata and import context influence grouping. Review the result after importing a few books, especially when filenames do not clearly identify a series or volume.

Correct names and grouping

  1. Touch and hold a Series and choose Edit Series to adjust its name, reading direction or cover. Save your changes.
  2. Inside a Series, touch and hold a Volume and choose Edit Volume to correct its display title or volume number.
  3. If a book belongs elsewhere, use Move to Series from its context menu. Choose a compatible destination in the same library and media type, review the move, and confirm.
  4. To combine two groups of the same kind, open a Series context menu and use Merge into Series. Review the destination and confirmation before applying.

Return to the book you were reading

Use Continue Reading on Home to reopen the recent in-progress book. A Series also provides Continue Reading for an unfinished Volume. Reading progress is kept on this device; this is not cross-device synchronization.

Use Mark as Read or Mark as Unread in a Volume’s context menu to manage its reading status. These commands change the status in your library, not the original story content.

Put selected Series in Private Library

  1. Open Settings, find Private Library, and tap Open Private Library. Complete the device authentication prompt.
  2. You can choose Show in Sidebar under Access Method, or use Hidden Access by touching and holding the Panelune icon in the sidebar. Authentication is still required.
  3. For a Series in the main library, touch and hold it and choose Move to Private Library, then authenticate when asked. To return it, unlock Private Library and use Move to Main Library.

Know what Private Library protects

Private Library separates selected books behind device authentication, such as Face ID, Touch ID or the device passcode where available. It does not create a Panelune account or upload your books to a Panelune server.

This is an access-control feature, not a promise of a separate encrypted vault. Original copies outside Panelune, including linked source files, remain accessible wherever you stored them.

Manage storage without losing originals

For linked books, Remove from Library removes the library entry while the original stays in Files. For an imported book, Delete Volume removes its local file from the iPad. Read the confirmation before deleting and keep your originals backed up.

The free version allows up to 3 Series while permitting additional Volumes in existing Series. Panelune Pro removes the Series limit through a one-time purchase with no subscription. Check the current regional price in the app; purchase restoration is described in Support.
